title: The Pink Suit Law Student Costume
intro: The pink suit is the only costume that works at a party and in a meeting the week after. Hot pink, fitted, buttoned properly, with pearls and a velvet headband doing the heavy lifting. If you are going to be the law student in pink, commit to the suit.

images.alt: Overhead flat lay on white linen of a hot pink skirt suit, pink patent pumps, a pink satchel, a pearl necklace, a pink velvet headband, a laptop sleeve and two pink mini pumpkins.
Woman taking a full length mirror selfie in a bright bedroom, wearing a hot pink skirt suit, pearls, a pink velvet headband and pink patent pumps, holding a pink satchel.
